scope: Lever 2 measured protected-delta package for the direct source-free electron-flow candidate sidecar route. It consumes the candidate-sidecar readout and the current approved train/cal feature sidecar, emits the exact smoke and remaining current-split delta rows needed for a future protected import, reconstructs the delta-applied sidecar states, and reruns the fixed gates from those reconstructed rows. It does not edit the approved sidecar, labels, registries, imports, thresholds, model weights, or heldout splits.
